title.zh: Anthropic says Claude used for cyberattacks and surveillance
title.en: Anthropic says Claude used for cyberattacks and surveillance

current_state.zh: Anthropic reported that Russian- and Chinese-speaking operators used its Claude model to automate cyberattacks against more than 20 government, diplomatic, and intelligence targets, while a Mali consultant built a mass-surveillance platform with the AI.
